lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Souvenirs\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
1 use of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.
lib/Http/ImageResponse.php:54 OC_Image

Nothing in the app calls 1 route outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 81 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. The frontend puts the path of the app and the rest of a URL together at run time, so every text there that reads like a path below the app counted as a call. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).
GET /index.php/apps/souvenirs/apiv2/share  souvenirs.api2.get_share_by_user  appinfo/routes.php:10 routes

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.
